briefings.title: Bill Ackman Outlines The Activist Playbook To Reinstate Jensen Huang | Silicon Valley & The World

people.name: Bill Ackman
people.role: Hedge fund manager, Pershing Square Capital Management

briefings.tldr: At Semafor’s Silicon Valley & The World, billionaire activist investor Bill Ackman outlined how he would theoretically run a campaign to reinstate ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang—though he noted his direct involvement is "unlikely."

briefings.title: Bill Ackman on the worst position in his portfolio and why he is still holding it

people.name: Bill Ackman
people.role: Founder and CEO, Pershing Square Capital Management

briefings.tldr: Bill Ackman identifies Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac as his portfolio's worst-performing yet highest-upside position, while explaining why dominant cash-generating compounders like Microsoft and Netflix remain core holdings despite recent market turbulence.

briefings.title: Conversation with Pershing Square Capital Management Founder & CEO Bill Ackman | GIS Mexico City '26

people.name: Bill Ackman
people.role: Founder and CEO, Pershing Square Capital Management

briefings.tldr: Bill Ackman identifies the artificial intelligence revolution as the definitive economic driver of 2026–2028, remaining highly bullish on compute demand and capital sustainability while noting that high debt levels will keep interest rates persistently high.

briefings.title: Bill Ackman: People are Going to Lose a Lot of Money
briefings.tldr: Bill Ackman breaks down his investment philosophy, the future of AI and market bubbles, and how a family medical emergency inspired him to build a world-class brain institute.

briefings.title: Bill Ackman: Here's What the Market is MISSING
briefings.tldr: Pershing Square CEO Bill Ackman discusses his shift toward backing durable, non-disruptable, founder-led businesses in the AI era, while outlining his strategy to transform the Howard Hughes Corporation into a long-term compounding machine modeled after Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway.
